meta.name: dnanexus-integration
meta.description: Build and operate reproducible genomics workloads on DNAnexus with the dx CLI, dxpy, apps/applets, native workflows, dxCompiler, and Nextflow. Use for DNAnexus data transfers, dxapp.json development, execution monitoring, workflow import, and project automation.

copy.tagline: 在DNAnexus上构建和运行可复现的基因组学工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在DNAnexus平台上自动化基因组学数据处理和运行分析流程
copy.tagline_en: Build and run reproducible genomics workflows on DNAnexus
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate genomics data processing and run analysis pipelines on the DNAnexus platform

howto.what: 装上这个技能后,Claude 能帮助你在 DNAnexus 云平台上完成基因组学数据分析和流程开发:创建和部署应用(app/applet)、上传下载文件、运行和监控任务、用 dxpy 写脚本、配置 dxapp.json 等。
howto.when: 当你要求创建或修改 DNAnexus 应用/applet、上传下载或查找文件、运行或监控分析任务,或配置项目与依赖时,会触发。

say.text: 帮我把本地的 sample.fastq 上传到 DNAnexus 项目里
say.note: Claude 会用 dxpy 上传并创建文件链接。

say.text: 用 dxpy 写个脚本,批量下载项目里的 BAM 文件
say.note: Claude 会生成并运行下载脚本。

say.text: 帮我创建一个能运行 bwa 比对的 applet
say.note: Claude 会生成 app 代码和 dxapp.json。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can help you build and run genomics workloads on DNAnexus: create and deploy apps/applets, upload and download files, run and monitor jobs, write dxpy scripts, and configure dxapp.json.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create or modify DNAnexus apps/applets, manage data files (upload/download/search), run or monitor analyses, or configure project dependencies, etc.

say_en.text: Upload my local sample.fastq to the DNAnexus project.
say_en.note: Claude will use dxpy to upload and create a file link.

say_en.text: Write a dxpy script to batch-download BAM files from the project.
say_en.note: Claude will generate and run the download script.

say_en.text: Create an applet that runs bwa alignment.
say_en.note: Claude will generate app code and dxapp.json.
